f3_program: collection("hani_and_diana.situps", "situp", "hani_and_diana", source("the total number of situps they did together"))
member("hani_and_diana.situps", "hani_and_diana.situps.hani", source("Hani said she would do 3 more situps per minute than Diana would"))
observe(at("hani_and_diana.situps.diana.rate", "session"), 4, "count_per_minute", source("a rate of 4 situps per minute"))

offset(at("hani_and_diana.situps.hani.rate", "session"), at("hani_and_diana.situps.diana.rate", "session"), 3, "count_per_minute", source("Hani said she would do 3 more situps per minute than Diana would"))

rate_relation(at("hani_and_diana.situps.diana.count", "session"), at("hani_and_diana.situps.diana.rate", "session"), "diana_situp_session.duration", source("Diana then did 40 situps at a rate of 4 situps per minute"))
assumptions: The source does not state that Hani performs situps for the same duration as Diana, so Hani's count and the requested combined total are underdetermined.
The first requested value is interpreted as the first "Forfeited" row, belonging to the activity period beginning January 1, 2017; the question does not state that period's ending date.
Parenthesized forfeiture entries are represented as positive magnitudes because the question asks for the number of shares forfeited.
The repeated "Forfeited" row labels make the table-cell evidence non-unique.

f3_program: offset(at("cj.stamps.count", "current"), scale(at("kj.stamps.count", "current"), 2), 5, "count", source("CJ has 5 more than twice the number of stamps that KJ has"))
fraction_of(at("kj.stamps.count", "current"), at("aj.stamps.count", "current"), 1, 2, source("KJ has half as many as AJ"))
observe(at("boys.stamps.total.count", "current"), 930, "count", source("the three boys have 930 stamps all together"))

sum_relation(at("boys.stamps.total.count", "current"), at("cj.stamps.count", "current"), at("kj.stamps.count", "current"), at("aj.stamps.count", "current"), source("the three boys have 930 stamps all together"))
